body:
Instead of the big ternary, could we have the following in l.34?

```js
{!isFromSearch && searchable ? highlighted : label}
```

that would use `label` when it's searchable, but not searching (so it would be inconsistent with refinement list). Another option however could be:

```
{searchable ? !isFromSearch && highlighted : label}
```

but that's essentially the same as the existing code, but with the ternary two times
